VIS-001.name: ArchivalScanCard
VIS-001.use: Best use: a real document or quote as proof (a page, a letter, a paper), with the quoted words highlighted. Limit: max 30% of runtime. Not for: a page with nothing highlighted or said about it.

VIS-002.name: MinimalDataChart
VIS-002.use: Best use: one statistic or contrast that the line says out loud (two or three bars, one hero). Limit: max 6 beats per episode. Not for: numbers the narration doesn't say.

VIS-003.name: HeadlineMatchCut
VIS-003.use: Best use: showing scale (many headlines or pages saying the same thing). Limit: max 3 beats per episode, at most one per act. Not for: a single source.

VIS-004.name: ParallaxCutout
VIS-004.use: Best use: the first appearance of a named person or a hero subject. Limit: max 8 beats per episode. Not for: repeating a portrait already shown.

VIS-005.name: SpotlightIsolator
VIS-005.use: Best use: one small detail inside a crowded picture or page. Limit: max 8 beats per episode. Not for: a picture whose whole frame is the point.

VIS-006.name: CleanUICard
VIS-006.use: Best use: web pages, specifications or museum records shown as evidence. Limit: max 6 beats per episode. Not for: text the narrator reads in full.

VIS-007.name: ChapterSlate
VIS-007.use: Best use: the turn into each act (chapter number and title). Limit: max 8 beats per episode. Not for: mid-act headings.

VIS-008.name: SplitComparisonCard
VIS-008.use: Best use: showing what stays the same against what changes (the flower, the candle and the stockings are the same; only the person looking changes). Limit: max 8 beats per episode; 2-4 panels, every panel a registered source. Not for: data with numbers (MinimalDataChart) or two versions of one picture (SwatchRows).

TXT-001.name: HeadlineArchivoBold
TXT-001.use: Typeface for Archival Desk (LOK-001) headlines and big numbers. Limit: only in episodes using that theme; a typeface, not a picture, so no beat cap.

TXT-002.name: EditorialSerifQuote
TXT-002.use: Typeface for Archival Desk quotes and titles. Limit: only in episodes using that theme; no beat cap.

TXT-003.name: MonoDataCounter
TXT-003.use: Typeface for Archival Desk dates, sources and counters. Limit: only in episodes using that theme; no beat cap.

TXT-004.name: BodyPlusJakartaUI
TXT-004.use: Typeface for Archival Desk body text and UI labels. Limit: only in episodes using that theme; no beat cap.

MOT-001.name: SpringCameraDrift
MOT-001.use: Best use: the one slow move on a still picture or a held shot (calm limit 3%). Limit: one move per shot; never stacked with another camera move. Not for: diagrams that already move.

MOT-002.name: SpringEditorialReveal
MOT-002.use: Best use: entrances of headlines, labels, charts and underlines. Limit: one entrance per element; no beat cap (it is a motion rule, not a picture).

MOT-003.name: SpringSnappyLock
MOT-003.use: Best use: brackets, highlights and cards that lock on. Limit: one lock per element; no beat cap.

MOT-004.name: MatchCut4FrameCadence
MOT-004.use: Best use: only inside HeadlineMatchCut (VIS-003). Limit: follows VIS-003 (max 3 beats per episode).

MOT-005.name: VectorTraceConnector
MOT-005.use: Best use: a route between two places on a map (Eaglesfield to Kendal) or a link between two named things the line says belong together (John and Jonathan). Limit: max 6 beats per episode; one trace on screen at a time. Not for: decoration, or arrows that point at what a label already names.

TRN-001.name: HardCutEyeTrace
TRN-001.use: Best use: the default cut between beats, keeping the focal point within 25% of the screen. Limit: no beat cap (it is the plain cut); use PushThrough or a slate only where they add meaning.

TRN-004.name: InfiniteCanvasGrid
TRN-004.use: Best use: runs of scenes on one idea inside an act. Limit: scene changes between ideas keep their designed transitions (TRN-006/007/011-013).

LOK-001.name: DarkArchiveOpticalStack
LOK-001.use: Best use: archive-led episodes (old papers, photos, maps). Limit: the episode's theme, chosen at Gate 0; one theme per episode.

LOK-006.name: TornPaperTapeOverlays
LOK-006.use: Best use: one label on the hero element of a shot. Limit: max 6 per act; never over a face or a page's text.

SFX-001.name: SoftWhoosh
SFX-001.use: Best use: a light beam or a camera move starting, rising into the next cut, in a pause. Limit: max 6 beats per episode. Not for: under narration words, or every transition.

SFX-003.name: MechanicalShutter
SFX-003.use: Best use: a flash from black or white, or a real photograph landing on screen, on the frame it lands. Limit: max 4 beats per episode; one per photo, never per collage piece. Not for: text or diagrams.

SFX-005.name: MutedThump
SFX-005.use: Best use: one big number or reveal landing, in the pause after the line. Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: ordinary labels.

SFX-006.name: CardstockSlide
SFX-006.use: Best use: a real page or document arriving on screen, in the pause before its line. Limit: max 10 beats per episode. Not for: text cards or diagrams.

SFX-007.name: SoftKeyClick
SFX-007.use: Best use: a window, button or cursor on a screen scene (LOK-023), a search being typed; rotate files (a click, then a key press: Moran's variety). Limit: max 6 beats per episode. Not for: paper or analog scenes.

TEX-001.name: GraphPaperDeskFrame
TEX-001.use: Best use: data and diagram acts. Limit: one ground per act; not under period scans (they keep their own paper).

LOK-009.name: WarmGraphiteLightLab
LOK-009.use: Best use: light-and-colour science episodes (the default for Where Colour Lives). Limit: the episode's theme, chosen at Gate 0; one theme per episode.

TXT-009.name: FrauncesLineSerif
TXT-009.use: Typeface for Warm Graphite (LOK-009) spoken lines, quotes and titles. Limit: only in episodes using that theme; a typeface, not a picture, so no beat cap.

TXT-010.name: JetBrainsMonoLabel
TXT-010.use: Typeface for Warm Graphite tags, labels, dates and sources. Limit: only in episodes using that theme; no beat cap.

TRN-006.name: PushThrough
TRN-006.use: Best use: when the next shot grows out of a key picture in the last one (a detail becomes the next scene). Limit: max 14 beats per episode (raised from 8, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026); never two in a row. Not for: ordinary cuts (use TRN-001).

LOK-010.name: OpticalStack
LOK-010.use: Best use: the frame layer (grain, grade, vignette) on every beat. This is the one asset meant to be on every frame, because it is the frame itself, not a picture. Limit: none, by design.

VIS-011.name: ColourPathMap
VIS-011.use: Best use: the 20-second 'previously' at the start of each episode, and one return near the end to show which stops are now lit. Limit: max 3 beats per episode. Not for: explaining one idea mid-act.

VIS-012.name: ConeTrio
VIS-012.use: Best use: a line that names the three cone types, or one that is missing (Young's guess, Dalton's answer, olo). Limit: max 6 beats per episode. Not for: general colour talk with no cones in it.

VIS-013.name: ConeCurveChart
VIS-013.use: Best use: where the overlap of the three curves is the point (two lights that look the same, why olo needs a laser). Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: episode 1, before cones are introduced; never as decoration.

VIS-014.name: SpectrumStrip
VIS-014.use: Best use: a line that names wavelengths or the band of colours (Newton's spectrum, Dalton's six against his two). Limit: max 5 beats per episode. Not for: background colour or transitions.

PKG-005.name: SeriesTitleCard
PKG-005.use: Best use: once, right after the cold open. Limit: max 1 beat per episode.

PKG-006.name: EpisodeCard
PKG-006.use: Best use: once, straight after the series title card. Limit: max 1 beat per episode.

MUS-005.name: SeasonBed
MUS-005.use: Best use: one bed family under narration for the season, chosen with Sam per episode. Limit: drops out under the biggest reveal of each act. Not for: the cold open's first line.

MUS-006.name: SeasonSting
MUS-006.use: Best use: under the series title card only. Limit: max 1 beat per episode.

SRC-009.name: ManchesterPlan1794
SRC-009.use: Best use: the dateline for Dalton's 1794 talk in Manchester (WCL-E01 act 3: MANCHESTER · 31 OCT 1794), and other 1790s Manchester beats in the season. Limit: max 4 beats per episode; always with a dateline tag, never alone. Not for: Manchester after about 1800 (the map is 1794), or any other town.

SRC-011.name: CandleLighting_Mixkit3458
SRC-011.use: Best use: the candlelit evening in Kendal (episode 1's opening and its return in act 7). Limit: max 14 beats per episode (raised from 8, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: any other scene.

SRC-013.name: Geranium_Stang
SRC-013.use: Best use: Dalton's geranium (the flower he names in his paper). Limit: max 20 beats per episode (raised from 10, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: generic flowers. Licence CC BY-SA 4.0: shown unaltered except grade, credited.

SRC-014.name: Laurel_RunicEarth
SRC-014.use: Best use: Dalton's laurel-leaf example (1798 p. 34) beside the red sealing-wax (SRC-015), WCL-E01 act 3, and the act 5 return (sunlight on the geranium and a laurel leaf). Limit: max 3 beats per episode. Not for: generic leaves or greenery.

SRC-015.name: SealingWax_Petrik
SRC-015.use: Best use: Dalton's red sealing-wax example (1798 p. 34) beside the laurel leaf (SRC-014), WCL-E01 act 3. Limit: max 3 beats per episode; shown cropped to the seal, no writing. Not for: letters, post or seals in general.

SRC-017.name: RGBPixels_Mixkit258
SRC-017.use: Best use: a screen's red, green and blue sub-pixels: WCL-E01 act 7 (the phone question) and WCL-E02's cold open (a phone screen under a microscope). Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: generic tech or 'digital' mood.

SRC-018.name: CursorPixels_Mixkit3818
SRC-018.use: Best use: white made from three tiny lights (a white cursor seen as red, green and blue sub-pixels), WCL-E02's cold open answer, after SRC-017. Limit: max 3 beats per episode. Not for: computers or the internet in general.

SRC-020.name: BlueSky_Mixkit2408
SRC-020.use: Best use: the blue sky in WCL-E05 act 4 (Rayleigh: why the sky is blue). Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: weather, travel or flight.

SRC-022.name: EarthViews_NASA
SRC-022.use: Best use: the thin blue layer of air seen from orbit, WCL-E05 act 4 (Rayleigh scattering). Limit: max 3 beats per episode; no NASA logo, no endorsement implied. Not for: space or 'the planet' as mood.

SRC-024.name: BerkeleyCampus_2026
SRC-024.use: Best use: the dateline for the Oz experiment (WCL-E06 act 4: BERKELEY · 2025). Limit: max 3 beats per episode; always with the dateline tag or the paper, never alone; credit 4300streetcar (CC BY 4.0). Not for: universities in general.

SRC-025.name: Fong2025_Fig1C
SRC-025.use: Best use: how the Oz system works (a laser raster aimed at single cones), WCL-E06 act 4. Limit: max 3 beats per episode; credit 'Fong et al., Science Advances 2025 · CC BY 4.0' on screen. Not for: eyes or lasers in general.

SRC-026.name: Fong2025_Fig1A_1B
SRC-026.use: Best use: the real retina patch and its cone map, WCL-E06 act 4 (which cones the laser hits: the medium cones Dalton lacked). Limit: max 4 beats per episode; credit on screen; any layout drawn from it is tagged ILLUSTRATIVE. Not for: retinas in general.

SRC-027.name: Fong2025_Fig2A
SRC-027.use: Best use: the olo result (how far outside normal colours it sits), WCL-E06 act 4. Limit: max 2 beats per episode; credit on screen. Not for: colour wheels or gamuts in general.

SRC-028.name: StockmanSharpe2000_ConeFundamentals
SRC-028.use: Best use: only as the data inside ConeCurveChart (VIS-013). Limit: follows VIS-013. Not for: hand-drawn curves elsewhere.

LOK-011.name: VoidTheme
LOK-011.use: Best use: a whole episode built around one mystery, or a cold open told one lit object at a time. Limit: the episode's theme, chosen at Gate 0; one theme per episode. Not for: episodes carried mostly by documents or data.

LOK-012.name: MapRoomTheme
LOK-012.use: Best use: an episode about places and journeys (drawn maps, parchment documents). Limit: the episode's theme, chosen at Gate 0; one theme per episode. Not for: lab or light experiments.

LOK-013.name: FederalPrintTheme
LOK-013.use: Best use: an episode about print, design, pigments or dyes, carried by printed pages. Limit: the episode's theme, chosen at Gate 0; one theme per episode. Not for: soft, emotional episodes.

VIS-015.name: PerspectiveGrid
VIS-015.use: Best use: only where 3D space carries the meaning: a light path through a room (Newton's shutter, prism, Experimentum Crucis, lens), a line of sight (Ransome looking through the eye), or places laid out on a tilted map. Limit: max 8 beats per episode; max 8% of runtime; only in acts where the story is in a physical space. Not for: documents (use ArchivalScanCard), comparisons, numbers, titles, or decoration.

VIS-016.name: FootagePlate
VIS-016.use: Best use: a real clip or photo that sets a scene (a candle in a dark room, a place) with its dateline or label. Limit: max 24 beats per episode; max 15% of runtime (raised from 12 at act 1 Gate 1 and from 16 at act 2 Gate 1, Sam, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: documents (ArchivalScanCard) or a named person's first appearance (ParallaxCutout).

VIS-017.name: SwatchRows
VIS-017.use: Best use: comparing what different people see (by day against by candle; John, his friends, his brother). Limit: max 12 beats per episode (raised from 8, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: data with numbers (MinimalDataChart).

VIS-018.name: YearCounter
VIS-018.use: Best use: one big span of time said out loud (151 years). Limit: max 2 beats per episode. Not for: dates (DatelineTag) or small numbers.

VIS-019.name: EyeDiagram
VIS-019.use: Best use: lines about the eye itself (Dalton's tinted-jelly idea, the request, Ransome's examination). Limit: max 10 beats per episode. Not for: lines about light or the brain with no eye in them.

VIS-020.name: KineticLine
VIS-020.use: Best use: a hinge question or one key label the viewer must keep (WHERE IS THE PINK?). Limit: max 12 beats per episode (raised from 6, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: repeating what the narration says word for word, or decoration.

TXT-011.name: DatelineTag
TXT-011.use: Best use: the first time a new place or date opens a scene. Limit: max 24 beats per episode (raised from 12, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: every line with a year in it.

SFX-013.name: CandleStrike
SFX-013.use: Best use: the candle being lit at the episode's very start (and again only if the story returns to that evening). Limit: max 2 beats per episode. Not for: transitions.

SFX-014.name: CandleRoomTone
SFX-014.use: Best use: under the candlelit Kendal scene only. Limit: max 10 beats per episode; max 10% of runtime. Not for: diagrams or documents.

SRC-029.name: Dalton1798_p30
SRC-029.use: Best use: the beats where Dalton's own words about the geranium and his brother are quoted. Limit: max 10 beats per episode. Not for: decoration.

SRC-030.name: WCL-E01_Act1_Narration
SRC-030.use: Best use: act 1 of WCL-E01 only. Limit: this act's narration, once. Not for: any other act, episode, trailer or Short without Sam's say-so.

VIS-021.name: RayParticles
VIS-021.use: Best use: only where light physically travels: through Newton's shutter hole, the prism split, the second prism, a lens bringing rays back together, light entering the eye and reaching the back. Limit: max 6 beats per episode; max 5% of runtime; 40 dots on screen at most. Not for: decoration, data or money flows, or any line with no light in it.

LOK-014.name: DepthFog
LOK-014.use: Best use: dark-room perspective-grid shots where depth carries the meaning (Newton's room, Ransome's look-through). Limit: only inside VIS-015 shots; max 8 beats per episode; fog 0.6 at most. Not for: flat shots, documents or titles.

VIS-022.name: EyeDissection
VIS-022.use: Best use: the request to examine Dalton's eyes and the examination itself (acts 1 and 6). Limit: max 8 beats per episode; max 6% of runtime. Not for: how the eye works in general (EyeDiagram section mode), or any shot that would show real tissue.

TRN-007.name: SlideAcross
TRN-007.use: Best use: moving into or out of a document, or between two documents (a scene change, not within a scene). Limit: max 16 beats per episode (raised from 8, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026); never two in a row. Not for: cuts inside one scene (TRN-001) or a detail growing into the next shot (TRN-006).

VIS-023.name: GlyphMosaic
VIS-023.use: Best use: act numbers and the numbered keepers at an episode's end; one hero word per episode. Limit: max 8 beats per episode. Not for: body text or labels.

VIS-024.name: ScaleField
VIS-024.use: Best use: one big-number scale reveal (millions of colours, 1 in 12 men). Limit: max 12 beats per episode (raised from 2, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: small numbers (use YearCounter) or decoration.

VIS-025.name: PictureToShape
VIS-025.use: Best use: a real image whose shape carries the point. Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: pictures without a shape to show.

VIS-026.name: SourceWall
VIS-026.use: Best use: the evidence-pile moment (many papers and reports at once). Limit: max 3 beats per episode. Not for: a single source (ArchivalScanCard).

VIS-027.name: StillsMontage
VIS-027.use: Best use: a long span said out loud (a hundred and fifty-one years), years passing in a life. Limit: max 3 beats per episode; one burst of motion per montage. Not for: comparisons.

TXT-012.name: KeywordSlab
TXT-012.use: Best use: the one word the viewer must keep in a beat. Limit: max 12 beats per episode; never two on screen; only in themes with a condensed face (e.g. LOK-013). Not for: full sentences.

TXT-013.name: RunningHead
TXT-013.use: Best use: acts longer than 2 minutes, so the viewer always knows where they are. Limit: one per act; off during title cards, quotes and full-frame pictures. Not for: short acts.

PKG-007.name: NumberedKeepers
PKG-007.use: Best use: an episode or season ending that gives the viewer rules to keep. Limit: once per episode, 3-5 items. Not for: recaps of facts.

LOK-015.name: AnalogueFinish
LOK-015.use: Best use: candlelit, archival and memory scenes. Limit: max 15% of runtime; never on diagrams or text-heavy beats. Not for: the whole episode.

LOK-016.name: CandleFlicker
LOK-016.use: Best use: candlelit scenes (Kendal 1792, the 1844 room). Limit: max 12 beats per episode; only where a flame is on screen or just off it. Not for: daylight or diagrams.

MOT-009.name: LineBoil
MOT-009.use: Best use: our own line drawings (map pins and rings, routes, connectors, hatched period drawings). Limit: max 16 beats per episode; amplitude <= 2 px. Not for: text, photos, real scans or data charts.

TEX-005.name: EngravingHatch
TEX-005.use: Best use: drawn period objects and scenes (a diary, a room, instruments). Limit: max 10 beats per episode. Not for: modern scenes, photos, real scans or text.

MUS-007.name: WholesomeBed
MUS-007.use: Best use: the bed under the narration of WCL-E01, running through every act (it carries on across acts; it never stops, only dips). Limit: at -33 LUFS before ducking, sidechain-ducked under the voice, dips under the season sting and on deadpan or reveal lines (at most 2 a minute). Not for: the series title sting itself, or another episode without Sam hearing it there.

SRC-031.name: Dalton1808_Plate4
SRC-031.use: Best use: Dalton's atomic theory (1808): beside his portrait, or when atoms are named. Limit: max 4 beats per episode; shown as the plate or its one-ink line mask (changes credited). Not for: decorating unrelated chemistry.

LOK-017.name: HalftoneMoire
LOK-017.use: Best use: the beat where a colour itself is questioned. Limit: max 2 beats per episode, at most once per act; moire opacity <= 0.3. Not for: decoration or a whole act.

VIS-028.name: DuotoneCollage
VIS-028.use: Best use: a life or idea told from several period pieces at once. Limit: max 4 beats per episode; 2-4 pieces a shot. Not for: one photo or a page to read.

TEX-006.name: PrintScreenOverlay
TEX-006.use: Best use: held full-frame photos of objects or places (the stockings photo). Limit: max 6 beats per episode; strength <= 0.15. Not for: text, scans of pages, diagrams or faces.

SFX-015.name: CountLockTick
SFX-015.use: Best use: the lock of a counter or a key number, on the word, with SFX-005 under it. Limit: max 4 beats per episode, at -16 dB or quieter. Not for: labels, page highlights or transitions.

TEX-007.name: PaperFibre
TEX-007.use: Best use: every paper piece on screen. Limit: inside each piece only, low strength. Not for: digital UI or diagrams.

TXT-015.name: FillSweep
TXT-015.use: Best use: the one word a line turns on. Limit: one fill per line, max 6 per act. Not for: whole sentences.

TRN-008.name: TraceToPicture
TRN-008.use: Best use: a first appearance. Limit: max 3 per episode. Not for: documents to read.

PKG-008.name: SeriesThread
PKG-008.use: Best use: act changes and chapter cards.

LOK-018.name: TopLightSheen
LOK-018.use: Best use: title and chapter cards.

TRN-009.name: ShapeMorphCut
TRN-009.use: Best use: shape-to-shape scene changes. Limit: max 2 per act.

LOK-019.name: ShadowPass
LOK-019.use: Best use: held period photos and candlelit rooms. Limit: max 6 beats per episode.

MAP-005.name: FocusDim
MAP-005.use: Best use: maps where one place is spoken about. Limit: max 4 beats per episode.

VIS-029.name: ContrastCallout
VIS-029.use: Best use: page shots where one or two lines are read aloud. Limit: max 6 beats per episode.

LOK-021.name: RisoPlate
LOK-021.use: Best use: mixing and printing beats. Limit: max 4 beats per episode.

LOK-022.name: GateWeave
LOK-022.use: Best use: held archival stills and cards. Limit: weave <= 1.5 px.

MOT-011.name: ExtremeEase
MOT-011.use: Best use: the one crisp move of an act (a reported colour snapping to cherry red, a card locking on a reveal). Limit: max 1 per act. Not for: entrances in general (MOT-002) or camera moves.

MUS-008.name: ActMoodCueSheet
MUS-008.use: Best use: planning each act bed.

VIS-030.name: PeriodFrame
VIS-030.use: Best use: era footage. Limit: max 3 per episode.

LOK-020.name: DeskDepthOfField
LOK-020.use: Best use: pages as objects. Limit: max 6 beats per episode.

VIS-031.name: Photo25D
VIS-031.use: Best use: held real photos. Limit: max 4 per episode.

MAP-006.name: TerrainTintMap
MAP-006.use: Best use: moves between places. Limit: max 4 beats per episode.

LOK-023.name: ScreenMedium
LOK-023.use: Best use: screen beats and pictures on a display. Limit: max 4 beats per episode.

TXT-017.name: MarkerHighlight
TXT-017.use: Best use: one key word per headline line. Limit: max 4 per act.

MAP-007.name: SatelliteCutout
MAP-007.use: Best use: places seen from above. Limit: max 4 beats per episode.

TRN-010.name: CutOnAction
TRN-010.use: Best use: scene changes where something moves.

MUS-009.name: DocPulseBed
MUS-009.use: Best use: analytic or tension acts; Sam picks first.

VIS-032.name: LensDive
VIS-032.use: Best use: the moment the eye is examined and its pay-off. Limit: max 2 beats sets per episode.

SFX-016.name: PaperFoley
SFX-016.use: Best use: under a whoosh when the thing moving is paper (a collage scrap, a torn note, an archival page sliding), 8-10 dB under the hero; alone, quietly, when a page settles. Rotate the three files. Limit: max 10 beats per episode; never on every collage piece (one per shot). Not for: text cards, diagrams, or a document arriving (SFX-006).

SFX-017.name: InkLineFoley
SFX-017.use: Best use: a line or highlight drawn on paper (a trace drawing on, a marker highlight, an underline), on the draw. Limit: max 6 beats per episode; only the shot's hero line, never every arrow or label. Not for: lines on a screen (use SFX-007) or diagrams that build without a hand.

SFX-018.name: StopwatchTicks
SFX-018.use: Best use: creative texture under a line or chart line moving, a timeline running, or time passing; low, under the hero. Rotate v1-v3. Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: the lock of a number (SFX-015) or a clock that is on screen and silent in the story.

SFX-019.name: SwitchDial
SFX-019.use: Best use: something switching on or opening (a light, a shutter or hole opening, a lens ring opening), and a dial or focus being set. Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: buttons on a screen (SFX-007).

SFX-020.name: LowWhoosh
SFX-020.use: Best use: the hero sound of a camera move or something emerging (a push-in, a slide cut, a dive into a lens), starting 0.1-0.2 s before the move; rotate v1/v2/v3. Limit: max 8 beats per episode, one per shot; sits in a pause or 20 dB under the voice. Not for: every cut, text or arrows appearing.

SFX-021.name: AirClothWhoosh
SFX-021.use: Best use: a fast line or object sweeping across (air), a window, panel or sheet folding away (cloth). Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: slow calm moves (SFX-020).

SFX-022.name: ProjectorAmbience
SFX-022.use: Best use: under shots about film, light being projected or archive footage (Newton's beam in a dark room, an old film plate), 24-30 dB under the voice, starting 0.2-0.5 s before the cut (J-cut) and fading out at the scene's end. Limit: max 3 scenes per episode, max 10% of runtime. Not for: modern or digital scenes.

SFX-023.name: AnalogNoise
SFX-023.use: Best use: under old-media scenes (a record, a tape, an old radio or TV, an old room with a lamp) 26-32 dB under the voice, J-cut in. Limit: max 3 scenes per episode, max 10% of runtime. Not for: digital scenes, or on top of the room tone SFX-014.

TRN-011.name: PaperBandWipe
TRN-011.use: Best use: scene changes inside a collage or paper act (one page of the story to the next), on a pause. Limit: max 14 per episode (raised from 6, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026), never two in a row; calm speed (0.5-0.7 s). Not for: cuts inside a scene.

TRN-012.name: ColourBlockWipe
TRN-012.use: Best use: a chapter or act turn where a colour carries the meaning (the red Dalton saw, the season sting colour). Limit: max 2 per act (raised from 2 per episode, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: ordinary scene changes (TRN-011, TRN-006).

TRN-013.name: FlashFrame
TRN-013.use: Best use: between two type cards or two pages on the same idea (one quote to the next). Limit: max 2 per episode, never at a calm reflective moment. Not for: real photos of people.

SFX-024.name: AirSwish
SFX-024.use: Best use: a paper band, colour block or panel wiping across (TRN-011/012/013, TRN-007 slide), starting 0.05-0.15 s before the wipe; rotate v1-v3. Limit: max 30 per episode (raised from 8, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026), 16-22 dB under the voice. Not for: camera pushes (SFX-020) or text appearing.

SFX-025.name: SubImpact
SFX-025.use: Best use: the act's one impact: right after a 0.3-0.6 s music break (MUS-010), or a hard cut into a new idea; in a pause. Limit: max 2 per episode, never two in one act. Not for: under a spoken number (SFX-015/005).

MUS-010.name: BreakAndImpact
MUS-010.use: Best use: the act's peak reveal and the season or episode title. Limit: max 1 per act; the break sits in a pause, never over words. Not for: reflective acts.

MUS-011.name: BedFilterSweep
MUS-011.use: Best use: a scene change on a wipe when the bed is busy. Limit: max 14 per episode (raised from 4, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026). Not for: Sam's voice (never filtered).

TXT-018.name: MacroPaperType
TXT-018.use: Best use: a quote from a primary source set as typed text (Dalton's own lines from 1794/1798), held 4 s or more. Limit: max 4 per episode. Not for: modern or digital sources.

LOK-024.name: LensFocusPocket
LOK-024.use: Best use: macro shots of paper, type and pages (TXT-018, ArchivalScanCard close-ups). Limit: max 8 shots per episode; heavy to render, so use on stills only. Not for: diagrams that must stay sharp.

VIS-033.name: CursorElement
VIS-033.use: Best use: anything that lives on a computer: a search, a website, a database (the 1995 study online, a modern colour test). Limit: max 4 shots per episode. Not for: paper scenes.

MAP-008.name: RadioRings
MAP-008.use: Best use: marking 'here' on a map (Eaglesfield, Kendal, Manchester) the first time the place is named. Limit: max 3 ring moments per episode, each held over at most 4 beats. Not for: decoration without a place.

MAP-009.name: TiltedRouteDraw
MAP-009.use: Best use: a journey or an invasion route (Dalton to Manchester; any move between places). Limit: max 3 per episode. Not for: maps that need exact reading.

VIS-034.name: CutoutRig
VIS-034.use: Best use: anonymous period figures in engravings (a soldier, a crowd, a worker). Limit: max 4 shots per episode. Not for: any real, named person (no invented speech or gestures for real people; our rule), or photos.

SRC-032.name: WCL-E01_Act2_Narration
SRC-032.use: Best use: act 2 of WCL-E01 only. Limit: this act's narration, once. Not for: any other act, episode, trailer or Short without Sam's say-so.

MAP-010.name: PeriodMapPlate
MAP-010.use: Best use: where a real place in the story is first named (Eaglesfield, Kendal, Manchester) and a move between them. Limit: max 8 beats per episode; always a real period map underneath, never a modern map for an old story. Not for: decoration or a place said in passing.

VIS-035.name: ReportedColour
VIS-035.use: Best use: one object that different people reported as different colours (the stockings: John and Jonathan dark, their mother cherry red). Limit: max 16 beats per episode (raised from 10, Sam approved at WCL-E01 act 2 Gate 1, 22 Nov 2026); always tagged as reported colours, never presented as a measurement. Not for: what colour-blind people 'really see'.

SRC-033.name: CumberlandWestmorlandMap_1760
SRC-033.use: Best use: Dalton's two home places, Eaglesfield and Kendal, and the route between them (act 2). Limit: max 10 beats per episode; always captioned BOWEN · 1760. Not for: claims about the 1790s landscape the map does not show.

SRC-034.name: QuakerAdvices_Plainness
SRC-034.use: Best use: the Quakers' plainness, in Dalton's words about his family (act 2, beats 6-7). Limit: max 4 beats per episode; quote only the lines on the page. Not for: a general picture of Quakers.

SRC-035.name: Dalton1793_MeteorologicalObservations
SRC-035.use: Best use: Dalton's habit of writing everything down (act 2, beats 8-9). Limit: max 4 beats per episode. Not for: standing in for the 57-year weather diary (that is a separate handwritten journal).

SRC-036.name: Lonsdale1874_WorthiesDalton
SRC-036.use: Best use: naming the source of the stockings story and its distance in time (act 2, beats 22-24). Limit: max 4 beats per episode; small on screen (the scan is 1158 px tall). Not for: presenting the story as certain.

SRC-037.name: PeriodStockings_Rijksmuseum
SRC-037.use: Best use: the stockings story (act 2, beats 25-44), shown in each person's reported colour by VIS-035. Limit: max 20 beats per episode; always captioned STOCKINGS OF THE PERIOD · RIJKSMUSEUM, never as Dalton's own pair. Not for: other clothing stories.

VIS-036.name: LiveTally
VIS-036.use: Best use: one quantity that grows while the viewer watches (a sourced rate per second). Limit: max 1 per episode; the chip carries its source line. Not for: a fixed number (use MonoDataCounter) or a rate we can't source.

VIS-037.name: ShareOut
VIS-037.use: Best use: a total turned into a per-person share, or 1 in N people (1 in 12 men). Limit: max 1 per act. Not for: proportions that aren't per person (use JarFill).

VIS-038.name: RescalingChart
VIS-038.use: Best use: growth that speeds up, said out loud ('it's speeding up'). Limit: max 2 per episode; real data with a source line only.

VIS-039.name: LedgerCard
VIS-039.use: Best use: a few named items from one real document compared (a list in a source). Limit: max 2 per episode; the items must come from the source, not invented.

VIS-040.name: RankSwap
VIS-040.use: Best use: a change in ranking over time. Limit: max 1 per episode; real ranked data only.

VIS-041.name: JarFill
VIS-041.use: Best use: a then-versus-now share or concentration. Limit: max 2 per episode; the tag says what one dot stands for.

VIS-042.name: RiseFromBehind
VIS-042.use: Best use: people tied to a place (a portrait rising behind its town or meeting house). Limit: max 3 per act; real photos only, credited. Not for: invented scenes with real people.

VIS-043.name: FootageLayer
VIS-043.use: Best use: a place whose motion matters (the sea, a mill's smoke). Limit: max 2 per act; Mixkit or NASA footage under its licence, never in git.

VIS-044.name: ExtrudedRegion
VIS-044.use: Best use: one region named in the narration (England, Cumberland). Limit: max 1 per act. Not for: routes (MAP-009).

LOK-025.name: OffsetMarkerStroke
LOK-025.use: Best use: midground figure cutouts in a collage act. Limit: one accent colour per act; never on a scan of a page.

TXT-019.name: LetterDrop
TXT-019.use: Best use: one hero number card per act. Limit: max 2 per act.

TXT-020.name: StrikeThrough
TXT-020.use: Best use: correcting a misconception said out loud. Limit: max 2 per episode; the correction must be sourced.

TXT-021.name: TypewriterLine
TXT-021.use: Best use: a closing line or a quoted line from a document. Limit: 1 per act.

SFX-026.name: SoftPop
SFX-026.use: Best use: the one cutout entrance that matters in a shot, texture level (22-24 dB under the voice). Limit: one per shot; never on every entrance (our hierarchy rule).

SFX-027.name: TypewriterKeys
SFX-027.use: Best use: under TXT-021 TypewriterLine, one key per letter at texture level. Limit: with TXT-021 only.
